title: Unit 9 Regional Consolidation: Belize, Suriname & The Guianas
goal: Synthesize understanding of the Guiana Shield, multilingualism in Belize and Suriname, and continental integration in a comprehensive case study.
grammar: síntesis del Escudo Guayanés, multilingüismo y fronteras caribeñas

items: Evaluate the ancient geomorphology and biodiversity of the Guiana Shield tepuis.
Trace Belize's Maya-Garifuna heritage and multilingual coexistence.
Appreciate Suriname's maroon autonomy and interreligious harmony in Paramaribo.
Analyze Guyana's offshore oil boom alongside French Guiana's European spaceport in Kourou.
Examine continental integration through CARICOM, OTCA, and Brazilian transborder bridges.
I can describe the geological antiquity of the Guiana Shield and its tepuis.
I understand Belize's intercultural mosaic and the significance of Garifuna heritage.
I can discuss Suriname's maroon history and religious tolerance.
I can explain the geopolitical contrast between Guyana's oil and Kourou's spaceport.
